title: Swift Horse
simplified_paragraphs: 有一白一黑两匹马，其中白色的是千里马，天生就有强壮的体魄，另外一匹黑色的马稍微差一些。
由于主人的收入不稳定，所以给它们的食物有的时候好，有的时候坏。于是，白千里马根据食物的好坏来决定奔跑速度，吃得好就跑快些，吃得不好就跑慢些。但是不管主人给的食物怎么样，黑马每次都会用力跑。
慢慢地主人发现，那匹白马有时跑得快，有时跑得慢，而黑马则越跑越快，于是在喂食物时，总是多给黑马一些。这样，千里马就更生气了，它想：你这么对待我，我也不会努力为你奔跑！
又过了一段时间，主人感觉白马跑得不如黑马快，而且越来越慢。终于有一天，他决定把白马放到磨房拉磨。
traditional_paragraphs: 有一白一黑兩匹馬，其中白色的是千里馬，天生就有強壯的體魄，另外一匹黑色的馬稍微差一些。
由於主人的收入不穩定，所以給它們的食物有的時候好，有的時候壞。於是，白千里馬根據食物的好壞來決定奔跑速度，吃得好就跑快些，吃得不好就跑慢些。但是不管主人給的食物怎麼樣，黑馬每次都會用力跑。
慢慢地主人發現，那匹白馬有時跑得快，有時跑得慢，而黑馬則越跑越快，於是在喂食物時，總是多給黑馬一些。這樣，千里馬就更生氣了，它想：你這麼對待我，我也不會努力為你奔跑！
又過了一段時間，主人感覺白馬跑得不如黑馬快，而且越來越慢。終於有一天，他決定把白馬放到磨房拉磨。
pinyin_paragraphs: yǒu yī bái yī hēi liǎng pǐ mǎ， qí zhōng bái sè de shì qiān lǐ mǎ， tiān shēng jiù yǒu qiáng zhuàng de tǐ pò， lìng wài yī pǐ hēi sè de mǎ shāo wēi chà yī xiē。

yóu yú zhǔ rén de shōu rù bù wěn dìng， suǒ yǐ gěi tā men de shí wù yǒu de shí hou hǎo， yǒu de shí hou huài。 yú shì， bái qiān lǐ mǎ gēn jù shí wù de hǎo huài lái jué dìng bēn pǎo sù dù， chī de hǎo jiù pǎo kuài xiē， chī de bù hǎo jiù pǎo màn xiē。 dàn shì bù guǎn zhǔ rén gěi de shí wù zěn me yàng， hēi mǎ měi cì dōu huì yòng lì pǎo。

màn màn de zhǔ rén fā xiàn， nà pǐ bái mǎ yǒu shí pǎo de kuài， yǒu shí pǎo de màn， ér hēi mǎ zé yuè pǎo yuè kuài， yú shì zài wèi shí wù shí， zǒng shì duō gěi hēi mǎ yī xiē。 zhè yàng， qiān lǐ mǎ jiù gèng shēng qì le， tā xiǎng： nǐ zhè me duì dài wǒ， wǒ yě bù huì nǔ lì wèi nǐ bēn pǎo！
yòu guò le yī duàn shí jiān， zhǔ rén gǎn jué bái mǎ pǎo de bù rú hēi mǎ kuài， ér qiě yuè lái yuè màn。 zhōng yú yǒu yī tiān， tā jué dìng bǎ bái mǎ fàng dào mò fáng lā mò。
english_paragraphs: There were two horses, one white and one black. The white horse was a swift horse, born strong and sturdy. The black horse was not quite as strong.

Because their owner’s income was unpredictable, the food he gave them was sometimes good and sometimes poor. The white horse adjusted its speed according to the food: when it ate well, it ran faster; when it didn’t, it ran slower. But no matter what food the owner gave them, the black horse always ran as hard as it could.

Gradually, the owner noticed that the white horse sometimes ran fast and sometimes ran slowly, while the black horse kept getting faster. So he always gave the black horse a little more food. This made the white horse even angrier. It thought, “If that’s how you treat me, I won’t run hard for you!”

After some time, the owner felt that the white horse could no longer run as fast as the black horse and was getting slower and slower. Finally, one day, he decided to send the white horse to work at the mill, turning the millstone.
english_full:
There were two horses, one white and one black. The white horse was a swift horse, born strong and sturdy. The black horse was not quite as strong.

Because their owner’s income was unpredictable, the food he gave them was sometimes good and sometimes poor. The white horse adjusted its speed according to the food: when it ate well, it ran faster; when it didn’t, it ran slower. But no matter what food the owner gave them, the black horse always ran as hard as it could.

Gradually, the owner noticed that the white horse sometimes ran fast and sometimes ran slowly, while the black horse kept getting faster. So he always gave the black horse a little more food. This made the white horse even angrier. It thought, “If that’s how you treat me, I won’t run hard for you!”

After some time, the owner felt that the white horse could no longer run as fast as the black horse and was getting slower and slower. Finally, one day, he decided to send the white horse to work at the mill, turning the millstone.
